title: Tutorial video: one task, step by step
description: A how-to clip for the docs or the tutorials page: one task in numbered steps, each a real capture of the step with the region that matters zoomed and called out.

body.subject: The task '{{task}}' in Lampway, shown as {{step_count}} numbered steps; each step uses its own capture from [image_references], in order.
body.action: For each step: the capture appears whole, then zooms to the region named in the step until its UI text is at least {{min_text_px}} px, a callout outlines the control, the step's caption holds for at least {{step_s}} s, then the next step.
body.camera: Zoom and pan on the capture only (a 2D scale and translate, eased in and out), one move per step; no rotation.
body.style: Night surface around the capture; captions in the site's sans on a plate; the step number in the flame accent; {{palette}}.
body.constraints: Write ONE scene folder: an HTML entry plus its JS, CSS, fonts and images, nothing fetched from elsewhere. Expose window.__scene = {duration_s, width, height}, an async window.__setup() that loads every font and decodes every image and reports each one, window.__frame(t) that sets EVERY animated property from t (seconds) alone, and window.__audit() that lists the visible text with its box, size and colour. No Date, performance.now, Math.random, requestAnimationFrame, CSS animations or CSS transitions: easing and any flicker are closed-form functions of t. All text inside the 5% title-safe area, at least {{min_text_px}} px tall at the output size, with contrast of at least 4.5:1 (3:1 at 24 px and up). No text over a busy image without a plate behind it. Every step's caption is the step text from {{steps_source}}, verbatim. A step whose capture is a design mock carries the tag 'Design, in progress'.

min_text_px.description: the smallest text at the output size; the self-check fails under 22

palette.default: the brand's own tokens from the supplied stylesheet
palette.description: where the colours come from; never invented

task.description: what the viewer learns to do

steps_source.description: where the step text is quoted from

negatives: no UI text left unreadable after the zoom

image_references.description: one capture per step, in step order (real captures of the running app where they exist)

gates.description: requests other than file: and data: during the render (the scene must be self-contained)
sampled frame with no visible mark: share of pixels carrying a local luminance step
warning only: a nearly empty sampled frame (a weak poster frame)
visible text box outside the 5% title-safe margin
measured contrast of fully visible authored text against the pixels around it (3.0 at 24 px and up)
authored text overlapping a figure or card box
frames differing when the receipt is re-rendered by verify (same engine, sequential order)
